How it works

## From enquiry to delivered bags

### Tell us the job

Bag type or just what you are packing, the size in millimetres if you know it, and the quantity.

### We price it

A price for that exact job, with the stock and handle we would use and what the deadline allows.

### Proof

Our studio sets the artwork on the die for your size and sends a PDF proof. Nothing moves until you approve it.

### Press and delivery

Litho, flexo or digital depending on the run, then delivered anywhere in the UK.

Questions

## Asked before most orders

+ What size should I order?

Measure the product, add a little for a hand going in, and send width × gusset × height in millimetres. If you would rather not measure, send a photograph of what you are packing and we will specify it.

+ Do you print on brown kraft and white?

Both, smooth or ribbed. Brown kraft takes one and two colour work beautifully; white or coated board is the one to use for photographic print.

+ Can I have a sample before ordering?

Yes, samples are free. Say which bags you want to see and where to send them.

+ What artwork do you need?

Vector is best: .cdr, .eps or a print-ready PDF in CMYK. A logo file or even a sketch is enough to start the quote.

+ Are the bags recyclable?

Uncoated paper and board go in kerbside recycling. A laminated bag has a film over the board, so it depends on local facilities - ask us for the stock specification on your job and we will tell you what is on it.

+ Do you deliver outside London?

Yes, anywhere in the UK. Delivery is confirmed with your quote.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paper bags for salons and beauty

Small, heavy and expensive: a bag of skincare weighs more than it looks, and the bag is handed over at the end of a treatment someone has just paid well for.

Get a price Size chart

The job

## What the bag has to do here

These are the bags where the finish does the talking. Gloss laminate on a dark board with a satin ribbon is the salon standard; matt with a foil-blocked mark is the quieter version of the same idea.

Because the contents are dense, the board is heavier than the size suggests. A 220 x 100 x 280mm bag in 250gsm handles a full retail sale without bowing.

  * Heavier board for dense products
  * A finish that matches the treatment room
  * Handles that feel soft in the hand
  * Small footprint, high perceived value

# Which bag do you need?

Three questions settle it in most cases. Answer them in your head and the shortlist is usually one or two bags.

Request a quote 0207 993 6533

Image: Which bag do you need?

## 1. What are you packing?

Small and light - a pastry, a prescription, a pot of cream: a counter bag or a small twisted handle bag.

Clothing or soft goods: a deeper gusset and a ribbon or rope handle, laminated or not depending on the look.

Heavy, boxed or bottled: 250gsm board with a rope handle or an external folded handle.

## 2. How heavy is a full bag?

Under a kilo, a 180gsm bag with twisted handles is enough. Two to four kilos needs 200-250gsm and a handle fixed through the top rather than glued to the inside face. Above that, talk to us before ordering.

## 3. Does it have to stand open?

If someone fills it one-handed at a counter, you want a block bottom. If it is handed over already packed, a flat bag is cheaper and stores better.

## Still not sure?

Email a photograph of what you are packing to help@custompaperbagsco.co.uk, or use the form below. A picture answers all three questions at once.

## Before you order

+ What if two bags would work?

That happens often. Ask for a price on both - the difference in unit cost usually decides it.

+ Can you recommend a size as well?

Yes. Send the product dimensions, or the product, and we will come back with a size.

# About Custom Paper Bags Co

We print paper bags. Not boxes, not fabric bags, not promotional merchandise with a bag thrown in: paper and card bags, printed and made to the size a business actually needs.

## How we work

A job starts with what goes in the bag. From that we choose the board weight, the handle and the shape, then set your artwork on the die for that size and send a PDF proof. Nothing is printed until you have approved it.

We quote the exact job rather than selling packages, because a bakery buying counter bags and a hotel buying rope-handle bags have almost nothing in common except the word bag.

## What we will not do

We will not claim a certification we cannot evidence, quote a lead time we have not checked, or sell you a bag we do not make. If a job needs a material outside paper and card, we will say so.

## Where we print

Custom Paper Bags Co is part of a group of print businesses working across the UK, United States and Australia. The sister sites are custompaperbagsco.com and custompaperbagsco.com.au.

Questions

+ Do you work with small businesses?

Yes. Tell us the quantity you have in mind and we will tell you what runs economically at that size.

+ Can I speak to someone before ordering?

Yes - call 0207 993 6533. It is faster than a form if you already know the bag.

+ Do you deliver outside the UK?

This site serves the UK. For the United States or Australia, use the sister sites.
